idea-plugin.name: Dependency License Lens
idea-plugin.description:
Dependency License Lens

Lists the dependencies declared in your project's root build files together with their license and a risk rating, so copyleft or policy-blocked licenses are visible before they reach a release.

Features

  • Build file parsing — Gradle (Kotlin DSL and Groovy DSL: build.gradle.kts, build.gradle), Maven (pom.xml) and npm (package.json) in the project root
  • Offline license lookup — built-in mapping of widely used libraries to SPDX identifiers and a built-in SPDX database (permissive, weak copyleft, strong copyleft); no network access
  • Risk levels — Safe, Caution, Warning and Blocked, taking into account whether the project is commercial
  • License policy — block a configurable list of SPDX identifiers (default GPL-2.0, GPL-3.0, AGPL-3.0)
  • Pre-commit check — when the policy is enabled and a commit touches a build file that declares a dependency with a blocked license, the IDE asks before committing
  • License Lens tool window — table of dependencies with version, license, category and risk, plus a summary

Dependencies the built-in mapping does not know are listed as Unknown with risk Caution.

Open Tools → Scan Dependency Licenses or the License Lens tool window. Settings live under Settings → Tools → Dependency License Lens.

Free and open source (Apache-2.0): github.com/JirakJ/dependency-license-lens

action.description: Scan project dependencies for license information
